name: const unsafe fn byte_offset_from < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : NonNull < U >) -> isize
rule: For safety, the distance between the data pointers of self and origin, in bytes, must be an exact multiple of size_of::<u8>() (1 byte), because byte_offset_from delegates to offset_from on u8 pointers; this divisibility requirement is always satisfied.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn byte_offset_from < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < U >) -> isize }
